renderings.value: I want to play a game where a noble female knight with the nickname "Light-Speed" freely manipulates gravity.
Gravity pulls things toward the center of the earth.
The gravity of the moon is one-sixth of that of the earth.
A galaxy is a cluster of stars, dust, and gas which is held together by gravity.
Astronauts are weightless and can sleep in any orientation. However, they have to attach themselves so they don't float around and bump into something.
